title: Inviting someone
goal: Invite friends and colleagues to do something, ask if they are free, suggest an activity and agree on a time and place.

items.fr: ça te dit de / tu veux / on pourrait + infinitif

drills.text: Ça te dit ___ venir au cinéma ?
drills.en: Do you feel like coming to the movies?
drills.explain: [[Ça te dit]] is followed by **de** + infinitive.

drills.en: We could go to the park on Saturday.
drills.explain: [[On pourrait]] + infinitive = we could… It is the softest way to suggest.

drills.en: How about going to a restaurant?

drills.prompt: Do you want to come with us? (formal)
accept: Est-ce que vous voulez venir avec nous ?
drills.explain: [[vouloir]] + infinitive, with **vous** for a formal invitation.

items.en: Do you feel like coming? (to a friend)
Are you free on Saturday evening? (to a friend)
accept: Est-ce que tu es libre samedi soir ?

items.en: What are you doing on Saturday? (informal)
We could go to the movies.

items.fr: Et si on allait prendre un café ?
items.en: How about going for a coffee?
accept: Et si on allait boire un café ?

items.en: I'm inviting you for supper (my treat). (to a friend)
items.note: In Québec, le souper is the evening meal; in France, le dîner.

items.en: Does that work for you? (to a friend)

example.fr: Il y a un 5 à 7 jeudi pour l'anniversaire de Nguyen.
example.en: There are after-work drinks on Thursday for Nguyen's birthday.

blocks.title: At the coffee machine, in an office in Montréal
blocks.context: Camille invites her colleague Raj to an after-work event.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Salut Raj ! Dis, tu es libre jeudi après le travail ?
lines.en: Hi Raj! Say, are you free on Thursday after work?

lines.speaker: Raj
lines.en: Thursday? Yes, I think so. Why?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: On organise un 5 à 7 pour l'anniversaire de Nguyen. Ça te dit de venir ?
lines.en: We're organizing after-work drinks for Nguyen's birthday. Do you feel like coming?

lines.speaker: Raj
lines.fr: Un 5 à 7 ? Qu'est-ce que c'est, exactement ?
lines.en: A “5 à 7”? What is that, exactly?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: C'est un apéro après le travail, entre collègues. On va dans un bar près du bureau, on prend un verre et on jase un peu.
lines.en: It's a drink after work, with colleagues. We go to a bar near the office, have a drink and chat a bit. (jaser = to chat, Québec)

lines.speaker: Raj
lines.fr: Ah, c'est sympa ! Ça commence à quelle heure ? On se retrouve où ?
lines.en: Oh, that's nice! What time does it start? Where do we meet?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Vers 17 h, au Bistro Saint-Denis. Tu peux arriver plus tard, si ça t'arrange.
lines.en: Around 5 p.m., at the Bistro Saint-Denis. You can arrive later, if that works better for you.

lines.speaker: Raj
lines.fr: Parfait, je vais venir. Et samedi, on pourrait aller voir le spectacle au parc, non ?
lines.en: Perfect, I'll come. And on Saturday, we could go and see the show in the park, couldn't we?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Bonne idée ! Et si on invitait aussi Amira ?
lines.en: Good idea! How about inviting Amira too?

blocks.title: Camille's email to the team
blocks.fr:
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,
Jeudi, Nguyen fête ses 30 ans ! Nous organisons un 5 à 7 au Bistro Saint-Denis, à partir de 17 h.
Ça vous dirait de venir ? Vous êtes toutes et tous invités, et vous pouvez venir avec votre conjoint ou votre conjointe.
Pouvez-vous me confirmer votre présence d'ici mercredi ?
Merci et à jeudi !
Camille
blocks.en: Hello everyone, On Thursday, Nguyen turns 30! We're organizing after-work drinks at the Bistro Saint-Denis, from 5 p.m. Would you like to come? You are all invited, and you can come with your partner. Can you confirm whether you're coming by Wednesday? Thanks, and see you Thursday! Camille

blocks.body: Compare the two: Camille says [[Ça te dit de venir ?]] to Raj face to face, and [[Ça vous dirait de venir ?]] in an email to the whole team. Same idea, different register.

blocks.title: Four steps of an invitation
blocks.body:
An invitation usually has four small steps:

- **Check if the person is free:** [[Tu es libre jeudi ?]] [[Tu fais quoi samedi ?]]
- **Invite or suggest:** [[Ça te dit de venir ?]] [[On pourrait aller au cinéma.]]
- **Give the details:** what, when, where: [[Vers 17 h, au Bistro Saint-Denis.]]
- **Agree on a place and time:** [[On se retrouve où ?]] [[Ça t'arrange ?]]

You already know most of the grammar: [[vouloir]] and [[pouvoir]] + infinitive, the futur proche, and questions with intonation, est-ce que or inversion.

blocks.title: Inviting: informal and formal
head: To do this
With a friend (tu)
Formal or a group (vous)
rows: Tu es libre samedi ? / Tu fais quoi samedi ?
Vous êtes libre samedi ? / Êtes-vous disponible samedi ?
Ça te dit de venir ? / Tu veux venir ?
Ça vous dirait de venir ? / Voulez-vous venir ?
On pourrait aller au parc. / Et si on allait au parc ?
On se retrouve où ? / Ça t'arrange ?
Où est-ce qu'on se retrouve ? / Ça vous convient ?
blocks.note: [[pourrait]], [[pourrions]] and [[dirait]] are a new tense, the *conditionnel*, which you will study at B1. For now, learn [[on pourrait]], [[nous pourrions]] and [[ça vous dirait]] as polite chunks: they mean *could* and *would*.

blocks.title: Ça te dit…?
blocks.pattern: Ça te dit de + infinitif ?  /  Ça te dit, + nom ?
blocks.note: Literally “does it say (something) to you?”, so: *do you feel like…?* It is friendly and very common. With **vous**: [[Ça vous dit…?]], or the extra-polite [[Ça vous dirait…?]]

examples.fr: Ça te dit de venir au 5 à 7 ?
examples.en: Do you feel like coming to the after-work drinks?

examples.fr: Ça vous dirait de souper avec nous ?
examples.en: Would you like to have supper with us?

blocks.title: Et si on…?
blocks.note: A very natural way to suggest something: *how about…? what if we…?* The verb is in the **imparfait**, but the meaning is about the future. Just learn the chunk.

examples.fr: Et si on allait à la cabane à sucre ?
examples.en: How about going to the sugar shack?

examples.fr: Et si on faisait un repas-partage ?

blocks.body:
- **Free = libre, not gratuit.** [[Tu es libre samedi ?]] = are you available? [[gratuit]] means *free of charge*: [[Le concert est gratuit.]] Saying *Tu es gratuit ?* is a classic (funny) mistake.
- **Don't forget de:** [[Ça te dit de venir ?]], not *Ça te dit venir ?*
- **Je t'invite means I'm paying.** [[Je t'invite au restaurant]] means *it's my treat*. To just ask someone along, say [[Tu veux venir avec nous ?]]
- **On pourrait, not on peut, for a soft suggestion.** [[On peut aller au cinéma]] is correct but sounds more like a statement of what is possible. [[On pourrait…]] sounds like a friendly idea.
- **Use à after inviter:** [[Je t'invite à mon anniversaire]], [[Je t'invite à souper]].

blocks.title: Invitations in Québec
blocks.body:
- **Le 5 à 7** is a Québec institution: drinks and snacks after work, usually from about 5 to 7 p.m. It is also used for parties: [[un 5 à 7 de lancement]] (a launch party). In France, people say [[un afterwork]] or [[un apéro]].
- **Ça te tente de…?** is the everyday Québec equivalent of *ça te dit de…?*: [[Ça te tente de venir ?]] In very informal speech you'll also hear [[Ça te tente-tu ?]] (the spoken *-tu* turns it into a yes/no question). Recognize it, but don't use it yourself, and never in writing.
- **Souper / dîner:** in Québec, [[le dîner]] is lunch and [[le souper]] is the evening meal. In France, [[le déjeuner]] is lunch and [[le dîner]] is dinner. Check before you show up at noon!
- **Jaser** (Québec) = to chat. In France: [[discuter]] or [[bavarder]].

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Invitations go **up** at the end, like a question. Smile: it really changes the sound.

lines.en: Are you free on Saturday evening?
lines.tip: Tu es: two vowels side by side, no pause.
In fast speech: ça t'dit d'venir ?

lines.en: We could go to the movies.

lines.fr: Et si on allait prendre un café ?
lines.en: How about going for a coffee?
lines.tip: on allait: link the n to the a.

lines.fr: Ça vous dirait de souper avec nous ?

blocks.fr: Salut Mei ! Tu fais quoi dimanche ? Ça te dit d'aller au marché Jean-Talon ? On pourrait se retrouver au métro vers 10 h.
blocks.en: Hi Mei! What are you doing on Sunday? Do you feel like going to the Jean-Talon market? We could meet at the metro around 10 a.m.
blocks.prompt: What is Mei invited to do, and when?
options: Go to a market on Sunday morning
Go to the movies on Sunday evening
Go to a market on Saturday morning
blocks.explain: [[dimanche]] = Sunday; [[aller au marché]] = go to the market; [[vers 10 h]] = around 10 a.m.

blocks.fr: Bonjour madame Tremblay. Nous organisons un souper d'équipe vendredi. Ça vous dirait de venir ?
blocks.en: Hello Mrs. Tremblay. We're organizing a team supper on Friday. Would you like to come?
blocks.prompt: Who is the speaker probably talking to?
options: Their manager or a senior colleague
blocks.explain: [[madame Tremblay]] and [[vous]] with [[Ça vous dirait]]: this is a polite, formal invitation.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Pay attention to tu and vous.

blocks.text: Ça te dit ___ prendre un verre après le travail ?
blocks.en: Do you feel like having a drink after work?

blocks.prompt: You want to invite your new manager, Mr. Gagnon, to the team supper. What do you say?
options: Monsieur Gagnon, ça vous dirait de venir au souper d'équipe ?
Salut ! Ça te dit de venir au souper ?
Monsieur Gagnon, tu es libre vendredi ?
Monsieur Gagnon, vous êtes gratuit vendredi ?
optionFeedback: Salut and tu are too familiar for a new manager.
Use vous with a manager, at least until he suggests tu.
Gratuit means free of charge. Available = libre or disponible.

blocks.prompt: Are you free on Saturday? (to a friend)
accept: Est-ce que tu es libre samedi ?
blocks.explain: [[libre]] = available. Days need no preposition: [[samedi]] = on Saturday.

blocks.prompt: We could go to the sugar shack.
accept: On pourrait aller à la cabane à sucre

blocks.prompt: How about going for a coffee?
accept: Et si on allait prendre un café ?
Et si on allait boire un café ?
On pourrait aller prendre un café ?
Ça te dit de prendre un café ?
Ça te dit d'aller prendre un café ?
Et si on prenait un café ?
blocks.explain: [[Et si on allait…?]] is the most natural *how about…?*. [[prendre un café]] = to have a coffee.

blocks.prompt: Match each phrase with its use.
pairs: Check if a friend is free

blocks.text: Et si on ___ Amira et Karim ? (inviter)
blocks.en: What if we invited Amira and Karim?
blocks.explain: [[Et si on]] + imparfait: on → [[invitait]] (stem *invit-* from [[nous invitons]], + -ait).

blocks.prompt: Your friend says: « Je t'invite au restaurant ce soir. » What does this usually mean?
options: Your friend is going to pay.
You will each pay for your own meal.
blocks.explain: [[Je t'invite]] usually means *it's on me*. To split the bill, people say [[on partage]] or [[chacun paie sa part]].

blocks.fr: Tu veux venir avec nous samedi soir ?
accept: Tu veux venir avec nous, samedi soir ?
blocks.explain: [[vouloir]] + infinitive: [[tu veux venir]]. [[veux]] ends in -x with tu.

blocks.text: Hier, Camille ___ invité toute l'équipe au 5 à 7.
blocks.en: Yesterday, Camille invited the whole team to the after-work drinks.
blocks.explain: Review: [[inviter]] takes **avoir** in the passé composé: [[elle a invité]].

blocks.prompt: Make two invitations. First, invite your manager (vous) to a team 5 à 7 on Thursday. Then invite a friend (tu) to do something on Saturday: check if they are free, suggest an activity, and agree on a time and place.
checklist: Vous with the manager: Ça vous dirait de… ?
Tu with the friend: Tu es libre / Tu fais quoi samedi ?
A suggestion: On pourrait… / Et si on allait… ?
A time: vers 17 h, à 19 h…

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour madame Roy. Jeudi, nous organisons un 5 à 7 pour l'équipe, au bar à côté du bureau. Ça vous dirait de venir ? … Salut Karim ! Tu fais quoi samedi ? Et si on allait au Vieux-Port ? On pourrait se retrouver au métro Champ-de-Mars vers 14 h. Ça t'arrange ?
models.en: Hello Ms. Roy. On Thursday, we're organizing after-work drinks for the team, at the bar next to the office. Would you like to come? … Hi Karim! What are you doing on Saturday? How about going to the Old Port? We could meet at Champ-de-Mars metro around 2 p.m. Does that work for you?

blocks.prompt: Write a text message inviting a friend to a show, a market or a sugar shack this weekend. Ask if they are free, say what you want to do, and suggest a time and a meeting place.
blocks.promptFr: Écrivez un texto pour inviter un ami ou une amie.
checklist: Tu es libre… ? or Tu fais quoi… ?
Ça te dit de… ? or Et si on… ?
A time and a meeting place

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Sofia ! Tu es libre dimanche ? Ça te dit d'aller à la cabane à sucre avec Raj et moi ? On pourrait partir vers 10 h. On se retrouve devant chez moi ? Ça t'arrange ? Bisous !
models.en: Hi Sofia! Are you free on Sunday? Do you feel like going to the sugar shack with Raj and me? We could leave around 10 a.m. Shall we meet in front of my place? Does that work for you? Love!

summary:
- Ask if someone is free: [[Tu es libre samedi ?]] [[Tu fais quoi samedi ?]]
- Invite and suggest: [[Ça te dit de…?]], [[Ça vous dirait de…?]], [[On pourrait…]], [[Et si on allait…?]]
- Agree on details: [[On se retrouve où ?]] [[Ça t'arrange ?]] — and remember: *free* = [[libre]], and [[je t'invite]] means it's your treat
